request: 两图改为疙宝在树上往下看的视角，先看效果；不接入或部署

Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: an alternate 3:2 hand-painted travel story postcard for the Sichuan countryside game 旅行癞疙宝.
Image 1 is the existing postcard to RECOMPOSE. Preserve its story, exact toad identity, countryside details and hand-painted visual language, but CHANGE the camera and relocate the toad as requested. This is an alternate viewpoint, not a paste-on edit.
Viewpoint: camera up IN THE TREE, slightly above and behind/alongside the toad, looking diagonally DOWN into the courtyard at a clear 50–60 degree downward angle. We must simultaneously see the toad on the nearby branch and the scene well BELOW it. Genuine elevated over-the-shoulder three-quarter perspective with foreshortened ground, chair seats and tabletops seen from above. No eye-level horizon or strip of sky; do not merely add a branch to the original eye-level composition.
Foreground: one sturdy natural branch growing from the courtyard tree enters the lower-left foreground and reaches toward lower-center. The ONE toad crouches securely on the branch, all short limbs grounded on/gripping the wood, leaning slightly forward and looking DOWN toward the activity below. Show three-quarter back/side and enough of one amber eye and cheek to retain its personality; gaze is at the story, not up toward the viewer. Keep the whole toad readable and unobscured. It occupies roughly 15–18% of image width as a near-camera foreground animal, not a giant next to people. Its one indigo floral bag sits securely in a wide branch fork immediately beside it, not floating or left on the ground. Tree canopy frames only the margins and does not hide the animal or key story.
Identity/style: same broad low squat olive toad, no neck, cream belly edge, orange bean-shaped parotoid glands, half-lidded amber eyes, short rounded limbs, few main warts. Same indigo satchel, single white flower flap, brass clasp, small red chili knot. Warm quiet storybook watercolor/gouache and brown contours, soft olive foliage, honey bamboo, cream/ochre masonry. Leaves in large simple planes, restrained texture and shadows, no extra fine speckles or noisy bark dots. Keep broad soft hand-painted shade rather than digital blur or bleaching.
No additional toads, no extra accessories, no treehouse, no climbing equipment, no spotlight/glow, no photo/3D, no caption/border/watermark. Complete opaque landscape PNG, native1536x1024.
Story below: the SAME two human men are having a quiet ear-cleaning session in the Chengdu outdoor tea courtyard. The cream-shirt customer reclines in a bamboo chair; the blue-gray-shirt practitioner stands/sits beside his head, delicately working near his human ear. Place them below the branch in the unobscured middle-right field of view, close enough to read the gentle hand/tool gesture from above. They remain human, the toad is ONLY WATCHING. Preserve bamboo seating, a small bamboo side table with lidded blue-white gaiwan, folded cloth and open dark tool roll, paving joints, tree shade, low gray-tiled white wall and teahouse. Rebuild these consistently for the high camera angle. Umbrellas may remain at the far margin but must not cover the two men. Keep surrounding furniture quiet, clearly distinguish the much nearer branch from the courtyard several metres below. Remove the old ground-level toad and bag entirely. No text anywhere. Primary visual story: a curious toad up in a tree peeking DOWN at somebody else receiving ear cleaning.
